verses.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.pt: Além disso fez um altar de bronze de vinte côvados de comprimento, vinte de largura e dez de altura.
verses.en_web: Then he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made a brass altar, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

verses.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.pt: Fez também o mar de fundição; era redondo e media dez côvados duma borda à outra, cinco de altura e trinta de circunferencia.
verses.en_web: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the great water-vessel of metal, round in form, measuring ten cubits across from edge to edge; it was five cubits high and thirty cubits round.

verses.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.pt: Por baixo da borda figuras de bois que cingiam o mar ao redor, dez em cada côvado, contornando-o todo; os bois estavam em duas fileiras e foram fundidos juntamente com o mar.
verses.en_web: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.en_bbe: And under it was a design of flowers all round it, ten to a cubit, circling the water-vessel in two lines; they were made from liquid metal at the same time as the water-vessel.

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.pt: O mar estava assentado sobre doze bois, três dos quais olhavam para o norte, três para o ocidente, três para o sul, e três para o oriente; e o mar estava posto sobre os bois, cujas ancas estavam todas para a banda de dentro.
verses.en_web: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
verses.en_bbe: It was supported on twelve oxen, three facing to the north, three to the west, three to the south, and three to the east, the water-vessel resting on top of them; their back parts were all turned to the middle of it.

verses.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.pt: Tinha quatro dedos de grossura; e a sua borda foi feita como a borda dum copo, como a flor dum lírio; e cabiam nele mais de três mil batos.
verses.en_web: It was a handbreadth thick; and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.
verses.en_bbe: It was as thick as a man's open hand, and the edge of it was curved like the edge of a cup, like a lily flower; it would take three thousand baths.

verses.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.pt: Fez também dez pias; e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavarem nelas; isto é, lavaram nelas o que pertencia ao holocausto. Porém o mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem nele.
verses.en_web: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.en_bbe: And he made ten washing-vessels, putting five on the right side and five on the left; such things as were used in making the burned offering were washed in them; but the great water-vessel was to be used by the priests for washing themselves.

verses.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.pt: E fez dez castiçais de ouro, segundo o que fora ordenado a respeito deles, e pô-los no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda.
verses.en_web: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the ten gold supports for the lights, as directions had been given for them, and he put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left.

verses.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.pt: Também fez dez mesas, e pô-las no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda; e fez ainda cem bacias de ouro.
verses.en_web: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
verses.en_bbe: He made ten tables, and put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made a hundred gold basins.

verses.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.pt: Fez mais o átrio dos sacerdotes, e o átrio grande, e as suas portas, as quais revestiu de bronze.
verses.en_web: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with brass.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made the open space for the priests, and the great open space and its doors, plating the doors with brass.

verses.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.pt: E pôs o mar ao lado direito da casa, a sudeste.
verses.en_web: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
verses.en_bbe: He put the great water-vessel on the right side of the house to the east, facing south.

verses.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.pt: Hurão fez ainda as caldeiras, as pás e as bacias. Assim completou Hurão a obra que fazia para o rei Salomão na casa de Deus:
verses.en_web: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for king Solomon in God’s house:
verses.en_bbe: And Huram made all the pots and the spades and the basins. So he came to the end of all the work he did for King Solomon in the house of God:

verses.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.pt: as duas colunas, os globos, e os dois capitéis no alto das colunas; as duas redes para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam no alto das colunas;
verses.en_web: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
verses.en_bbe: The two pillars, and the two crowns on the tops of the pillars, and the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the tops of the pillars;

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.pt: e as quatrocentas romãs para as duas redes, duas fileiras de romãs para cada rede, para cobrirem os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam em cima das colunas.
verses.en_web: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
verses.en_bbe: And the four hundred apples for the network, two lines of apples for the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the pillars.

verses.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.pt: Também fez as bases, e as pias sobre as bases;
verses.en_web: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases;
verses.en_bbe: And he made the ten bases and the ten washing-vessels which were on the bases;

verses.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.pt: o mar, e os doze bois debaixo dele.
verses.en_web: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
verses.en_bbe: The great water-vessel with the twelve oxen under it.

verses.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente as caldeiras, as pás, os garfos e todos os vasos, os fez Hurão-Abi de bronze luzente para o rei Salomão, para a casa do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for king Solomon, for Yahweh’s house, of bright brass.
verses.en_bbe: All the pots and the spades and the meat-hooks and their vessels, which Huram, who was as his father, made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of polished brass.

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.pt: Na campina do Jordão os fundiu o rei, na terra argilosa entre Sucote e Zeredá.
verses.en_web: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.en_bbe: The king made them of liquid metal in the lowland of Jordan, in the soft earth between Succoth and Zeredah.

verses.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.pt: Salomão fez todos estes vasos em grande abundância, de sorte que o peso do bronze não se podia averiguar.
verses.en_web: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; for the weight of the brass could not be determined.
verses.en_bbe: So Solomon made all these vessels, a very great store of them, and the weight of the brass used was not measured.

verses.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.pt: Assim fez Salomão todos os vasos que eram para a casa de Deus, o altar de ouro, as mesas para os pães da proposição,
verses.en_web: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house, the golden altar also, and the tables with the show bread on them;
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon made all the vessels used in the house of God, the gold altar and the tables on which the holy bread was placed,

verses.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.pt: os castiçais com as suas lâmpadas, de ouro puro, para arderem perante o oráculo, segundo a ordenança;
verses.en_web: and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;
verses.en_bbe: And the supports for the lights with their lights, to be burning in the regular way in front of the inmost room, of the best gold;

verses.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.pt: as flores, as lâmpadas e as tenazes, de ouro puríssimo,
verses.en_web: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was perfect gold;
verses.en_bbe: The flowers and the vessels for the lights and the instruments used for them, were all of gold; it was the best gold.

verses.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.pt: como também as espevitadeiras, as bacias, as colheres e os braseiros, de ouro puro. Quanto à entrada da casa, tanto as portas internas, do lugar santíssimo, como as portas da casa, isto é, do santuário, eram de ouro.
verses.en_web: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
verses.en_bbe: The scissors and the basins and the spoons and the fire-trays, of the best gold; and the inner doors of the house, opening into the most holy place, and the doors of the Temple, were all of gold.
